long_biography.plain_text:
Irish entrepreneur Denis O'Brien chaired the organising committee for the 2003 Special Olympics World Summer Games in Ireland. He helped raise the funds to stage the event and paid for the Iraqi team's participation. Money left after the Games supported an accredited course at Trinity College Dublin for people with intellectual disabilities.

His involvement with Concern Worldwide grew after visiting its work in Ethiopia in the early 2000s. He later served on its board, visited programmes in Kenya and South Sudan, and took part in the organisation's response to Haiti's 2010 earthquake.

confidence.reason: The recipient organisations directly document his organising role, specific funding and field involvement. No unsupported link between commercial outcomes and charity is asserted.
